framework.description: The single framework to scaffold the workshop app in

x-prompt.message: Which framework should this workshop use?

figmaMcp.description: Add the figma-console-mcp server (Figma Desktop Bridge) to .mcp.json

figmaFile.description: The attendee's own Figma file key (the segment in a Figma URL after /design/). When given, the generated figma:snapshot script and CLAUDE.md name it instead of the <YOUR_FIGMA_FILE_KEY> placeholder. No default and no x-prompt: most direct-preset callers do not have a key to hand, and the CLI (create-atelier-ui-workspace) owns the conversation that collects one.

skills.description: Install the storybookjs/mcp agent skills (stories, storybook-init, storybook-setup, storybook-upgrade) via the skills CLI during scaffolding. Requires network access; disable for CI or offline runs.
